summary_1line: Yudhishthira inaugurates Maya’s magnificent gem-built hall with vast charity to Brahmanas as sages and kings gather in celebration.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira enters the dazzling gem-studded hall of Maya while musicians, bards, and performers celebrate around him.
Thousands of Brahmanas are fed lavish dishes while the king gifts each a thousand cows in a grand act of charity.
The radiant sabha filled with sages, kings, and the Pandavas seated together beneath golden columns and jeweled walls.
